text: After the Second World War Germany was divided into East and West. East Germany (the GDR) built the Berlin Wall on 13 August 1961 to stop people leaving. It stood for more than twenty-eight years. On 9 November 1989 the border opened. Germany became one state again on 3 October 1990.

Tag der Deutschen Einheit, 3 October, is a public holiday. Many older Germans remember exactly where they were on 9 November 1989, so it is a good topic of conversation, but be tactful: this is personal history for many people.
